_comment: Negative fixture: high ranking score cannot create or promote Decision or BindingEvidence
_invariant: Recall ranking is a read-only projection. No ranking score, however high, may create a Decision, promote a DecisionCandidate to canonical, or materialize BindingEvidence without governed authority proof.
_expected: RecallPacket with high-scored candidates MUST NOT contain decision_id, binding_evidence, compliance_state, or signoff_approval in its serialized form. The packet's allowed_next_actions must not include any action that bypasses the governed promotion/signoff path.
_must_fail_if: high score creates or promotes Decision or BindingEvidence
